samples_reviewed.question_text: The number 573 is written in words as 'five hundred sixty-three'. True or False?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency requires representing numbers 'using pictorial models and numerals', but all 7 samples, including the new true_false seed 50 and cloze seed 72, are numeral-to-words tasks; no pictorial model (blocks, place-value chart, array) appears anywhere in the widened sample.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Across all 7 seeds and 3 different formatters (mcq, true_false, cloze), not one item produces a pictorial-model representation; the specific sub-case the competency's own wording names is entirely absent even after widening the sample.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Stems such as 'Write 139 in words.' (seed 72) are 4 words and well within grade 3 quarter 1 reading demand, whatever the mismatch to the named skill.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Formatter varies across the 7 seeds (mcq, true_false at seed 50, cloze at seed 72) but the underlying task content stays identical throughout -- numeral-to-words conversion or a words-form true/false check -- with no pictorial or place-value-chart variant in any format.

competency_alignment.rationale: 'Write 139 in words' (seed 72) is precisely the skill named by sibling competency mat_g3_na_q1_1 ('read and write numbers ... in numerals and in words'), so this node's own distinct pictorial-representation mandate goes untested even at 7 seeds.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The highest value across all 7 samples, including the new true_false seed's 573, is still 3 digits; the competency's stated ceiling is 10 000, and the observed range never reaches even four digits.
